title: ALSU Uzbek population genetics
summary: Array and imputed genotypes of ~1,256 Uzbek individuals: PCA, ADMIXTURE, FST, relatedness, GWAS. Currently being re-checked against a corrected reference.
about: Population-genetics analysis of an Uzbek cohort, run on the DRAGEN server. Outputs are a public GitHub site (Toki-bio/ALSU-analysis), a Russian-language report and a slide deck. In October 2026 the PBS selection candidates were found to come from errors in the 1000G GRCh38 call set, so the analysis is being redone on the NYGC 30x reference.

log: All ten FST pairs recomputed on NYGC; the 10-02 pairs reproduce exactly. Found merged.fam (1,193) that had been wrongly reported as not found. Report copy and deck updated (slides 11 and 12).

title: Sicista betulina genome
summary: ONT assembly of the northern birch mouse (primary: 2.99 Gb, N50 18.25 Mb, BUSCO 99.2%), plus mitogenome/NUMT findings and a first SINE scan.
about: Assembly of S. betulina (individual ZBS2026-Sb1, Bannikova lab ONT, about 104 Gb) on therioserver. Collaborators: Kim Cooper (UCSD), Michael Hiller (Senckenberg, will run TOGA2), Anna Bannikova, Vladimir Lebedev. Side questions: whether extra Illumina is needed, and why PCR fails (a ~200-copy nuclear lineage-B mtDNA-like family was found).
where: Gene BEDs and SINE cards: C:\work\Tal\sicista
plan: Evaluate the primary assembly (earlier numbers were hap1) and recommend it
Share primary assembly and raw reads with the Hiller lab
QC verdict: no extra Illumina needed on this individual (male, 35x ONT)
Mitogenome / NUMT analysis
Check the lab's actual PCR primers against the lineage-B family and the control-region repeat
Finish de novo SINE scan, Dip SINEderella, and orthologous loci vs S. trizona
More individuals for MSMC and population SINE frequencies
Request pod5 and metadata from the sequencing company
log: ONT-only PSMC and SINE-indel feasibility tests: robust above 60 ky, 25,313 heterozygous SINE-like indels on autosomes. Verdict: extra Illumina not needed on this individual.
Mito/NUMT study: real mtDNA is circular with a 312 bp ATACGC x52 control-region repeat; nuclear genome holds a ~200-copy lineage-B-type family. Unattended SINE scan launched on both genomes.
Audit found all earlier quoted numbers were hap1; the primary (1,144 contigs, N50 18.25 Mb, BUSCO 99.2%) is better on both metrics.

title: Crayfish mitogenome resubmission
summary: Corrected mitogenome and annotation for the crayfish submission, ready for table2asn. Waiting on the manual NCBI steps.
about: Investigation of NCBI errors on the original submission. The DRAGEN assembly was fragmented, so a local one was used. Final package: one base fixed (position 143, T to C), trnL2 added and cox1 shortened, a table parse error fixed, and a CYTB note reworded. Positions 15222 and 15224 were thinly covered and deliberately left unchanged.
plan: QC of original submission and annotation
From-scratch redo and circularity fix
Final fa and tbl built
Run table2asn (needs the .sbt template and the exe)
Upload to NCBI
log: Final corrected package built; only pos 143 changed, 15222 and 15224 left as they were.
QC found the .tbl parse bug and the missing trnL2; the DRAGEN de novo assembly was fragmented, so the local one is used.

title: Tropiocolotes 5-locus alignments
summary: New Tropiocolotes sequences (12S, 16S, CYTB, MC1R, c-mos) merged with all GenBank Tropiocolotes sequences and aligned with MAFFT. Stops at alignments.
about: Sequences received by e-mail (samples CN10xxx; 13-19 per locus) were put in context with a GenBank snapshot of 2025-10-11, one alignment per locus. The 12S, 16S and CYTB alignments are about 20,500 columns wide because the GenBank queries also return complete mitogenomes, so trim before any tree. No tree or other analysis is in the folder or the shell history. Reference paper: Machado et al. 2018.
where: Verified archive and description: KIT /data/V/toki/audit_V/Tropiocolotes_2026-10-04/ (Tropiocolotes_full.tar.gz 0.27 MB, README.md, MD5SUMS_original.txt)
Local copies of the supplied sequences, paper and spreadsheet: C:\work\tropiocolotes
plan: Download GenBank Tropiocolotes sequences per locus
Merge with the supplied sequences and align (MAFFT L-INS-i style)
Audit the KIT folder, archive it (verified) and write the description
Replace the KIT folder by README plus the tarball (waiting for the owner to run the cleanup)
Trim the mitogenome-wide alignments to the locus, then build trees
commands: esearch -db nucleotide -query "Tropiocolotes AND 12S" | efetch -format fasta > tropiocolotes_12s.fasta   # same for 16S, CMOS, MC1R, CYTB, MOS
